positions.title: Software Engineer III, YouTube Languages
positions.description: Backend engineer on YouTube Languages, working to increase accessibility of YouTube content across the world. Specifically focused on launching Lip Sync, expanding dubbing/captions features to more languages across YouTube, and evaluating LLMs for future use on the platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer III, Live Video Infrastructure
positions.description: Backend engineer on YouTube Live Infrastructure platform, focused on launching Multiview experience on YouTube TV.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Live Video Infrastructure
positions.description: New graduate backend engineer on YouTube Live Infrastructure platform, focused on improving quality of video processing for YouTube Live, Premieres, and YouTube TV.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Built library to automatically generate audio transcripts and captions for YouTube videos in C++ using Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API.
• Created framework to compare new library to current production captioning service by analyzing word error rate.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Built math problem-solving component for pre-release Chrome OS notebook platform in Angular and Typescript.
• Analyzed highly unstructured handwriting data to develop a heuristic to determine math problems.
